children: BP p.l.c. publishes provisional dividend dates

BP p.l.c. announces that today it has published its provisional forthcoming dividend dates (including announcement, payment, record and ex-dividend dates) for ordinary and preference shares at www.bp.com/financialcalendar for 2027.
These dates are indicative and may be subject to change.
